::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 31 st [1870]  
**From:** Wantage  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd)
The [Goslings](organizations/other_104.qmd) will not die.  I find we had better kill the useless members, and get some  quite young ones in keeping the questions easier-  We have now left only [Cricket](people/person_1603.qmd), [Frog](people/person_822.qmd), [Double Daisy](people/person_1161.qmd) and[Pixie](people/person_539.qmd) to whom is to be added

The Honble
[Alethea Colborne](people/person_317.qmd),
Beechwood
Plympton

I am not sure what she is to be called [^1]-  Can you still be Secretary even if you have no time for the Questions?  It would be a great help to me.  Frog [^2] proposes a new one but I have not the particulars of her yet.  I am going home on Thursday  I have had a very pleasant expedition all round Devon ending with Torquay and Ottery.  Frog suggests the Goslings writing their criticisms below Cackle, which would be amusing, I think

your affectionate
Mother Goose

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: Mary Fursdon was told Alethea Colborne was to be Bluebell on 10 July 1870.
[^3]: CMY was staying with Frog's parents the Butlers at Wantage Vicarage.
